package.name: corridor_perception
package.description:
Structural corridor perception from a 2D lidar: line extraction, corridor axis and surface classification, a motion-noise model, and replay of recorded rosbag2 data.
The perception core (geometry, scan, extraction, axis, process_noise) is numpy only and imports no ROS package, so it can be exercised without a sourced workspace. replay.py is the single exception and the reason for the dependencies below: deserialising a recorded /scan needs the message definition it was recorded with, and there is no numpy-only way to read a rosbag2. Those imports are function local, inside the loader, so importing anything else in the package stays ROS free.
